name: agntux-teams
description: Team coordination for AgntUX. Designs team data, lifts personal data into shared team views, and generates team-relevant action items via a per-team scheduled task.
recommended_ingest_cadence: Every 15 min, 7am–9pm local — dispatch floor for the team scheduled task; per-team cadences (default 60 min) override inside the skill body via teams/{slug}/data/team-config.md.
